purpose: Slicer scripted module offering one preset-driven panel for classification labels, ROI markups and segmentation annotation. It exports portable annotation packages (JSON plus NIfTI/NRRD segmentation) and can import them again.
summary: I found no malicious behavior, network access, package installation or unsafe deserialization in the files I read. I did not read all of AnnotationModel.py, SegmentationTab.py or ConfigurationScreen.py. The blocking problem is packaging. AnnotationPanel/CMakeLists.txt installs only AnnotationPanel.py, but the module imports about ten sibling Python files. In a catalog-built package those files would be missing and the module would fail to load. Minor items are generic top-level module names added to sys.path, writing presets into the module install directory, an unset icon resource, and the catalog entry tracking the moving "production" branch.
